a defective verb only used to supply certain
tenses of अद्, such as the Aor. and Desid.), cl. 2. and
1. P. घस्ति and घसति:

nd sing. अघस् or
अघत्; 2nd pl. अघस्त: Perf. जघस, जघसिथ,
जघास; 3rd pl. जक्षुस् (Part. Perf. जक्षिवस्,
fem. जक्षुषी); अघसत्, घत्स्यति, घस्तुम्, to
consume, devour, eat: Desid. जिघत्सति, to wish to
consume or devour, wish to eat; [cf. rt. जक्ष् and
ग्रस्; cf. also Gr. γαστήρ; Lat. gustus.]

घस, अस्, m. the eater or devourer; N. of a
kind of demon; also of a Rākṣasa; [cf. महा-घस
and प्र-घस.]

घास, अस्, m. food, meadow or pasture grass;
[cf. अश्व-घास and पूति-घास.]
—घास-कूट,
अम्, n. a hay-rick.
—घास-स्थान, अम्, n. pasture,
pasturage, food.
—घासे-अज्र, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. im-
pelling to consume, i. e. inviting or exciting appetite.
घास घास. See under rt. घस्.
घसि, इस्, m., Ved. food, victuals; [cf. घासि.]
घासि, इस्, m. fire or its deity (the all-consuming).

घस्र, अस्, आ, अम्, hurtful, injurious, mischievous,
= हिंस्र; (अस्), m. a day [cf. घ्रंस]; (अम्), n.
saffron.
घासक, (at the end of an adj. comp.) food, victuals.
